details.label: Summary
details.text: A localized risk of severe wind gusts will persist for the next couple hours

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A loosely organized cluster of thunderstorms is tracking northwestward across parts of south-central AZ -- southeast of the Phoenix metro. Meanwhile, an outflow boundary is moving southward toward this cluster. The ongoing cluster of storms and potential outflow collision will promote a locally favorable corridor for severe wind gusts -- given temperatures in the 100-105F range and very steep low-level lapse rates

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...65-80 MPH
